subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard accept a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed review-gate tool lifecycle, or should this stay within the existing status/tool flow?
rationale: The PR changes persisted lifecycle state and runtime completion behavior, so correctness fixes alone do not settle whether existing Workboard flows should fail closed without a reviewer orchestration path.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle after repairs
options.body: Accept the direction only after the PR preserves existing envelopes, blocks every no-review completion path, updates metadata/UI/docs/tests, and provides upgrade plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep existing statuses
options.body: Ask for a redesign that enforces review using the existing `review`/`done` lifecycle without adding `ready_to_merge` as durable state.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave this PR open or close it until Workboard has a maintainer-approved reviewer orchestration design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after the PR preserves existing envelopes, blocks every no-review completion path, updates metadata/UI/docs/tests, and provides upgrade plus real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Workboard lifecycle and metadata history for the surfaces being changed.
